conclusion: All three agents repaired the production behavior according to the independent 23-case grader, but none obtained a passing required public 10-case validation. The local registry test was blocked by loopback listen EPERM inside all agent sessions. The frozen validation gate correctly remains false. Only Typelatch has an additional observer omission caused by redirected output.
